{{Event infobox | level = 80 | location = Lost Basilica | id = | type = Meta event | start npc = Isgarren | previous = Survive the trap room | map1 = Lost Basilica ground floor map.jpg | map1-text = Interior map (ground floor) | map2 = Lost Basilica underground floor map.jpg | map2-text = Interior map (underground floor) | requires = voe }} [[The Basilica Vaults]] is a level 80 [[meta event]] that occurs in [[Starlit Weald]], at [[Lost Basilica]]. The events begins immediately after the previous event chain: {{event|Help Explorer Dhexx decipher the relics}} → {{event|Survive the trap room}}. == Dynamic events == ;Before event starts * ''The basilica vaults are currently sealed.'' ;During event * ''Isgarren has moved further into the basilica and requires assistance to unlock its secrets.'' ** {{event|Defeat the ancient defenses and gather their power for Isgarren}} *** {{event|Gather the loose magic for Isgarren}} **** {{event|Defeat the champion enchanted weapon}} * [[Isgarren]]
{{event bar}} {{event shield}} ;Success * ''Isgarren successfully unlocked the secrets of the basilica. Grab what you can before it's sealed away again.'' * ''Time until the basilica closes: 5:00'' ;Failure * ''Isgarren was forced to make a tactical withdrawal, but he will return to try again later.'' == Rewards == Each chest can only be opened once per day per account. * One large [[Seer Artifact Chest]] * Four small [[Seer Storage Chest]] == Dialogue == ;Talking to Isgarren to start chain : Ah, [[Wayfinder]]. Perhaps you can assist me. There is [[The Last Vault|a chamber]] within this wing of the temple that I wish to reach before the [[Inquest]] find it, but the defense systems are active. :{{dialogue icon|ready}} ''I doubt you'll tell me any more than that. Fine, I'll help.'' :{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Every time I go into an old temple, something tries to kill me.'' ;While Isgarren is opening the first door :'''Isgarren:''' ''I expect a great deal of resistance within.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''When Castora doesn't want you somewhere, it can be quite...insistent.'' ;Progressing through the basilica {{main|Defeat the ancient defenses and gather their power for Isgarren#Dialogue}} {{main|Gather the loose magic for Isgarren#Dialogue}} {{main|Defeat the champion enchanted weapon#Dialogue}} == Related achievements == * {{achievement|Dubious Exit}} * {{achievement|Lost No Longer}} * {{achievement|Treasures of the Last Vault}} [[es:Las cámaras de la basílica]]
title: The Basilica Vaults
